capabilities.summary: Neutral SHA-256, HMAC (SHA-1/256/512), constant-time compare, base64/base64url, hex, BLAKE3 text hash, canonical JSON, HMAC approval tokens, Ed25519 sign/verify, ECDSA P-256 and RSA PKCS#1 verify, AES-256-GCM and ChaCha20-Poly1305, HKDF-SHA256, PBKDF2, TOTP, system RNG and a zeroizing secret
policyNotes: Declaration-only: apps call this crate instead of hand-rolling HMAC, constant-time compare, base64 or approval tokens.
Wraps ring for the heavy primitives; apps must not add ring directly for these.
